title: Cyber Security & Infrastructure Engineer
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Cyber Security & Infrastructure Engineer

Experience 1.5 to 2 years

Department IT / Information Security

Employment Type Full-Time

Industry Fintech / NBFC

Location Ahmedabad, Gujarat

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive Cyber Security & Infrastructure Engineer with 1.5 years or more of relevant experience in IT infrastructure, cybersecurity operations, network security, system administration, and security monitoring. The candidate will help maintain a secure and reliable technology environment by implementing security controls, monitoring infrastructure, managing vulnerabilities, and supporting applicable regulatory and audit requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Cybersecurity Operations

* Monitor security alerts, system logs, and suspicious activities to identify potential threats.
* Support vulnerability assessments, penetration testing coordination, and remediation tracking.
* Help protect sensitive customer information, personally identifiable information (PII), and financial data.
* Support endpoint protection (antivirus/EDR), firewall, and intrusion detection/prevention controls.
* Assist with security incident investigation, documentation, escalation, and root cause analysis.
* Support Data Loss Prevention (DLP) controls to reduce unauthorized data sharing or transfers.

IT Infrastructure & Network Security

* Administer and monitor servers, operating systems, network devices, and cloud infrastructure.
* Support firewall rules, VPNs, access controls, network segmentation, and secure remote access.
* Perform system hardening, security patching, and operating system updates.
* Monitor infrastructure availability, performance, backups, and security configurations.
* Support cloud security and identity/access management in platforms such as Oracle Cloud, AWS, or Azure.
* Assist with backup, disaster recovery (DR), and business continuity (BCP) activities.

Identity & Access Management

* Manage user access provisioning, modification, and deactivation based on approved requests.
* Support role-based access control (RBAC), least privilege, and multi-factor authentication (MFA).
* Conduct periodic access reviews and identify inactive, excessive, or privileged access.

Security Compliance & Audit

* Support cybersecurity and IT control requirements applicable to an RBI-regulated NBFC.
* Assist with internal/external audits, VAPT, evidence collection, and audit response.
* Maintain asset inventories, access review records, patch reports, incident logs, and security documentation.
* Track audit observations and coordinate timely remediation with relevant teams and vendors.

Monitoring, Reporting & Incident Response

* Monitor events using available SIEM, EDR, firewall, and infrastructure monitoring tools.
* Escalate critical security incidents and infrastructure issues promptly.
* Prepare periodic reports on vulnerabilities, patch compliance, access reviews, security alerts, and infrastructure health.
* Coordinate with development, infrastructure, and third-party vendor teams to resolve security issues.

Required Technical Skills

* Networking: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, routing, and firewall fundamentals.
* Operating Systems: Windows Server and Linux administration.
* Security Tools: Exposure to firewalls, antivirus/EDR, vulnerability scanners, and SIEM platforms.
* Infrastructure: Server administration, patch management, backup solutions, and basic cloud security.
* Security Fundamentals: Vulnerability management, system hardening, access control, incident response, and log analysis.
* Cloud Platforms: Basic knowledge of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), AWS, or Microsoft Azure.
* Scripting: Basic Python, PowerShell, or Bash scripting is an advantage.
* Documentation: Ability to maintain technical documentation, security reports, and audit evidence.

Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* Minimum 1.5 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, IT infrastructure, network administration, or information security operations.
* Certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CCNA, Microsoft Security, or cloud security certifications are preferred, not mandatory.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Understanding of confidentiality and secure handling of customer information.
* Ability to coordinate with internal teams, auditors, and external technology vendors.
* Proactive approach to identifying and resolving security risks.
* Good communication, documentation, and incident reporting skills.

Preferred Certifications  
CompTIA Security+  
Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)  
ISO 27001 Lead Implementer

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely identification, tracking, and remediation of vulnerabilities.
* Security patch compliance across servers and endpoints.
* Timely closure of security audit observations.
* Completion of access reviews and appropriate privileged account controls.
* Timely detection, escalation, and documentation of security incidents.
* Monitoring of backup jobs and participation in recovery tests.
* Adherence to approved security policies and infrastructure hardening standards.

Note: The role supports the organization’s cybersecurity and infrastructure controls in line with applicable regulatory requirements, internal policies, and the organization’s risk profile.

Pay: ₹400,000.00 - ₹800,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund
* Work from home

Work Location: In person

title: Delivery Head
description:
**Title**: Head of Delivery

**Location**: Ahmedabad, India (on-site; travel to client geographies as needed)

**Reports to:** CEO

**Experience**: 10+ years in software services, 6+ years leading multi-account delivery

**Scope**: Full delivery P&L across all practices: AI, Enterprise Platforms, Data Engineering, Custom Software,CRM,CMS

**Type**: Full-time

**The role:**

The Head of Delivery owns every client engagement from signed SOW to renewal: scope, schedule, quality, margin and client satisfaction. This is a new leadership role, created to give our portfolio a single accountable owner as we scale AI-led and multi-system programs.

You will run delivery as a business, not a reporting function. You own the delivery P&L, the delivery operating model, and the managers who run our accounts. You collaborate with the CEO, who owns client relationships and new business, and with the CTO, who owns technology strategy, architecture standards and engineering practices.

Key responsibilities:

**Portfolio and P&L**

· Own delivery revenue, gross margin and utilization across all active engagements.

· Run monthly portfolio reviews covering health, burn, forecast, risk and margin for every account.

· Approve staffing plans and resource allocation across fixed-price, time-and-materials and dedicated-team models.

· Cut revenue leakage: unbilled effort, scope creep, bench cost and write-offs.

**Delivery operating model**

· Define and enforce one delivery framework: governance cadence, status reporting, change control, RAID management and release readiness.

· Set delivery KPIs and make them visible to leadership weekly.

· Embed AI-assisted delivery practices (planning, estimation, testing, documentation) in collaboration with the CTO.

· Standardize estimation so fixed-price bids reflect real delivery data.

**Client delivery governance**

· Act as the senior escalation point for delivery issues and recover at-risk programs.

· Run delivery-side steering committees and quarterly reviews with client stakeholders, alongside the CEO.

· Turn delivery performance into expansion: surface phase-2 and adjacent opportunities to the CEO.

**Pre-sales support**

· Validate scope, estimates, team shape and delivery risk on every proposal and SOW before it is signed.

· Join solutioning calls for large or high-risk deals.

**People and leadership**

· Lead, hire and develop delivery and project managers; build a bench of account-level leaders.

· Run performance reviews and succession planning for the delivery organization.

· Work with HR and practice heads on capacity planning, skills mix and hiring forecasts.

**Quality and compliance**

· Ensure delivery meets security and compliance obligations (GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2 where applicable) and client audit requirements.

· Run post-mortems on failed milestones and drive the fixes into the framework.

**Must-have requirements**

· 10+ years in IT services or product engineering services, with 6+ years leading delivery across multiple concurrent client accounts.

· Has owned a delivery organization of 150+ engineers.

· Direct P&L accountability: has been measured on margin and utilization, not only on schedule.

· Has run fixed-price, time-and-materials and dedicated-team engagements and can explain where each one loses money.

· Has delivered for enterprise clients in the US, UK, Europe or Middle East, including C-level stakeholder management.

· Has turned around at least one failing program; can describe what was changed and the result.

· Hands-on with delivery governance: estimation, change control, RAID, SOW review and resource planning tools.

· Technical enough to challenge an architecture or estimate; engineering background strongly preferred.

· Bachelor's degree in engineering or computer science.

**Nice to have**

· Delivery leadership on AI/ML, GenAI or data engineering programs taken to production.

· Experience with Salesforce, SAP, NetSuite or HubSpot implementation programs.

· Delivery for regulated industries such as healthcare, life sciences or BFSI.

· PMP, PgMP or equivalent; an MBA is a plus, not a substitute for delivery track record.

· Has built a PMO or delivery excellence function from scratch.

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund
* Work from home

Work Location: In person

title: Walk-in Drive - Data Engineer (Virtual)
description:

If you are a proactive problem solver with a strong technical background and a team player with a positive attitude, we want to hear from you.

title: Software Engineering Manager

### **Location:** **Ahmedabad, India (Remote option Available)**

### **Company Introduction**

Genea was built on a foundation of listening to and serving our commercial real estate customer’s needs starting with our flagship Overtime HVAC product. Over the years, we’ve earned the trust and loyalty of 21 of the top 25 largest commercial real estate companies in the US and continue to prove our value to them every day. Our clients depend on us to develop value-added technology solutions to solve other pain points in their operations. We have grown our product portfolio to serve the complex and expanding needs of property teams.

Genea is a family of solutions are designed to improve commercial real estate operations through cutting-edge technology. Revolutionize access control, streamline overtime HVAC, and economize submeter billing. Our host of cloud-based, automated solutions are built to cut costs, reduce admin times, and maximize the tenant experience.

Experiencing enormous growth with aggressive expansion plans, Genea is expanding a Software Development and Operations center in India and is looking for dynamic engineering leaders, who can become part of this already successful growth story, and partner in creating a world class team and products.

We are fully remote since pre-COVID times. We're US-based, with a development centre in Ahmedabad, India.

* Experience in microservice and event driven architecture
* Proficient in backend technologies, preferably JavaScript, but we’re open to other technologies
* Proficient in frontend technologies, preferably React, but we’re open to any other JavaScript - based frameworks like Angular, Vue, etc

* Excellent understanding of software development life cycles (SDLC) with experience guiding teams through planning, development, and rollout using best in industry agile practices

* Understanding of testing practices like writing unit/integration test cases

* Strong cross-functional collaboration and influencing skills at high levels
* Possess innate customer service skills including the ability to be empathetic, accurate, compassionate, responsive, resourceful, and conscientious
* Strong relationship management, strategizing, project management, problem solving, and change management skills
* Experience working with AWS is highly preferable. We work with AWS services like EC2, S3, Lambda, CloudWatch, SNS, RDS, SQS.

  

**How this opportunity is different than other?**

* Opportunity to work directly with the Chief Technology Officer and other Executives
* Opportunity to help create and lead a strong team of engineers and lead innovation and creation of best-in-class products
* Participate in helping shape the contours of the software development and influence outcomes
* Strong participation in engineering strategies and product deliveries
* Opportunity to work with cross geography teams and travel as necessary
* Participate in creating a fun, smart, passionate multi-cultural and merit-driven team
* You will be challenged and encouraged to broaden your and your team’s skills including access to personal development courses and learning platforms
* Regular social & philanthropic events

title: Senior Generative Engenier
description:
Advanced AI Engineer — Global AI Agent Ecosystem & Complete Project Execution

**Company:** Nova AI  
**Position:** Senior AI Agent Engineer / Autonomous Systems Architect  
**Work Arrangement:** 100% Remote  
**Hiring Priority:** Urgent  
**Project Focus:** End-to-end AI applications for clients

Mission

Research, evaluate, and leverage the global AI agent ecosystem to engineer complete, reliable, and commercially useful AI applications. The engineer must be capable of selecting the best available agents, models, frameworks, and development tools for each project rather than depending on a single AI platform.

Global AI Agent Ecosystem Expertise

The candidate should maintain broad, continuously updated knowledge of relevant AI agents and tools, including:

* **AI coding agents:** OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Gemini-based coding tools, and other suitable coding agents.
* **General-purpose task agents:** Research, browser-based execution, document generation, data analysis, and multi-step task automation systems.
* **Agent development frameworks:** OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, Google ADK, AutoGen and comparable frameworks.
* **Browser and computer-use agents:** Tools capable of interacting with websites, browser interfaces, and supported desktop workflows.
* **Business automation agents:** n8n, workflow automation platforms, API-connected agents, and enterprise automation systems.
* **Knowledge and research agents:** RAG systems, document-search agents, retrieval pipelines, and research assistants.
* **Multimodal agents:** Systems combining text, images, audio, video, or other supported modalities.
* **Open-source and self-hosted agents:** Tools suitable for privacy-sensitive, cost-conscious, or customized deployments.
* **Agent communication and integration:** MCP, API integrations, event-driven workflows, and interoperable tool interfaces.

Full-Project Engineering Responsibilities

The engineer must be able to:

* Investigate client requirements and identify the actual business problem.
* Research available agents and compare their capabilities, limitations, licensing, cost, and security.
* Design an architecture that combines AI agents with conventional software where appropriate.
* Develop complete frontend, backend, database, API, and AI functionality.
* Coordinate multiple agents through controlled workflows with explicit permissions and success criteria.
* Test generated code, validate model outputs, identify failures, and implement recovery mechanisms.
* Deploy the application, configure monitoring, document the system, and demonstrate its operation.
* Deliver source code, setup instructions, test results, and client handover documentation.
* Continue evaluating emerging tools and replace components when evidence shows a meaningful improvement.

Required Standard of Execution

The engineer should demonstrate the ability to turn an approved client requirement into a functional application with clear milestones, measurable acceptance criteria, and realistic delivery estimates.

The role requires independent problem-solving, practical engineering skill, technical research, and end-to-end ownership. AI agents must be treated as engineering tools whose outputs require validation—not as infallible systems.

Candidate Evaluation

Applicants should demonstrate:

* A working application built using one or more AI agents.
* A documented example of coordinating multiple agents or tools.
* Evidence of personally implemented and tested software.
* The ability to explain why particular agents were selected over alternatives.
* A reproducible deployment process, security considerations, and known limitations.

**Success criterion:** Deliver the best practical solution for each client—not the largest number of agents or frameworks in a project.Advanced AI Engineer — Global AI Agent Ecosystem & Complete Project Execution

title: Product Security- Embedded / IoT
description:
**Position:**  
Product Security- Embedded / IoT
  
  
**Job Description:**  
**Job Description:** Product Security Engineer, Embedded / IoT
  
  
**Experience:** 2 to 10 years
  
  
Role Overview
  
We are looking for product security professionals with hands-on experience in assessing and securing embedded systems and IoT products.
  
The role involves performing product security assessments, conducting VAPT, developing threat models and security requirements, reviewing security controls, and supporting SSDLC activities. The selected candidate will work closely with hardware, firmware, software, and product engineering teams to identify vulnerabilities, recommend practical mitigations, and validate remediation.
  
Key Skills
  
  

* Understanding of embedded product architecture, microcontrollers, processors, bootloaders, memory, storage, and embedded Linux and/or RTOS environments. Ability to interpret hardware block diagrams, relevant schematic sections, and firmware architecture.
* Hands-on experience assessing debug, programming, or communication interfaces such as UART, JTAG/SWD, SPI, I²C, and USB. Familiarity with device debugging, flash access, firmware acquisition, and evaluation of debug and readout protections.
* Experience with firmware extraction or acquisition, unpacking, filesystem analysis, configuration review, and static and/or dynamic analysis. Ability to identify hardcoded credentials, exposed secrets, insecure services, weak permissions, vulnerable components, and weaknesses in firmware update mechanisms.
* Experience conducting manual and tool-assisted security testing of physical devices, firmware, and exposed interfaces. Ability to validate vulnerabilities, distinguish false positives, demonstrate impact safely, and recommend relevant remediation.
* Working knowledge of threat modeling, attack-surface analysis, security risk assessment, product security requirements, secure design review, and security validation. Understanding of assets, data flows, trust boundaries, attack scenarios, and requirement-to-test traceability.
* Understanding of secure boot, firmware signing, secure OTA updates, rollback protection, authentication, authorization, cryptographic key storage, certificate management, secure communications, and production security configuration.
* Knowledge of TCP/IP and relevant embedded or IoT interfaces and protocols, such as Ethernet, Wi-Fi, BLE, CAN, MQTT, HTTP(S), and TLS. Experience capturing and analyzing traffic and assessing communication security.
* Ability to understand C/C code and develop or modify Python or shell scripts.
* Experience with relevant tools such as Ghidra or IDA, Binwalk, GDB, OpenOCD, Wireshark, Nmap, flash programmers, debug probes, and logic analyzers.
* Familiarity with SAST, SCA, and Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) analysis.

Job Responsibilities
  
  

* Review product architecture, hardware and firmware designs, interfaces, deployment environments, and use cases to identify assets, attack surfaces, trust boundaries, and security risks.
* Plan and execute hardware and firmware VAPT using black-box, grey-box, or white-box approaches, as applicable. Assess physical access, debug interfaces, firmware, operating-system configuration, services, communication interfaces, and device management interfaces.
* Perform firmware analysis, binary analysis, reverse engineering, and security-focused source code reviews where applicable. Investigate vulnerabilities and document reproducible evidence, root causes, and product impact.
* Develop and maintain threat models, security risk assessments, product security requirements, security test plans, test cases, and traceability records throughout the product lifecycle.
* Review and validate security controls, including secure boot, signed firmware updates, rollback protection, credential handling, access control, secure communications, and debug restrictions.
* Execute or review SAST, SCA, and firmware/binary scanning results. Analyze SBOMs, assess vulnerability applicability, eliminate false positives, and prioritize findings based on exploitability, exposure, and product impact.
* Prepare technical reports with findings, evidence, risk ratings, and actionable remediation recommendations. Collaborate with engineering teams, verify fixes, and document residual risks.
* Develop reusable testing scripts, procedures, and checklists. Support security activities within development and release workflows and assess newly disclosed vulnerabilities affecting supported products.

**Location:**  
IN-GJ-Ahmedabad, India-Ognaj (eInfochips)
  
  
**Time Type:**  
Full time
  
  
**Job Category:**  
Engineering Services

Set the quality bar through architecture, design, and code reviews in modern C\+\+, and be the escalation\-of\-last\-resort on hard issues.
* **Cross\-component versatility \& engineering excellence** — Deliver across a broad surface — Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, and trading UI enhancements — as customer commitments evolve. Drive engineering best practices across the POD: modern C\+\+ standards, multithreading and concurrency correctness, performance tuning, automated testing, and CI hygiene. Treat customer\-funded work as first\-class product code, not throwaway one\-offs, and build a POD that can flex across components without becoming shallow on any of them.
* **AI\-assisted engineering** — Champion the adoption of AI coding assistants and agentic tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, and internal AI tooling) across the POD to accelerate delivery, code review, test authoring, design exploration, and production diagnostics. Set the bar for responsible use — quality, security, IP protection, and human accountability for shipped code — and share patterns that work back into the wider engineering org.
* **SE \+ SQE leadership** — Lead a cross\-functional POD of Software Engineers and Software Quality Engineers. Foster a shared ownership model where quality is designed in, not bolted on, and where SQEs are equal partners in scoping, automation, and release readiness.
* **People management \& culture** — Line\-manage the POD: 1:1s, feedback, growth plans, hiring, and calibration. Build a fair, sustainable delivery culture that can absorb context switching and shifting priorities without burning people out or letting quality slip.
  

##### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**


**Essential Skills \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience), with 10 to 12 years of software engineering experience and 2\+ years managing a mid\-sized engineering team, including line management of engineers.
* Expert\-level hands\-on proficiency in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+11 through C\+\+20\) — able to review and write production\-grade code, and to lead deep technical discussions on architecture, multithreading, concurrency, and performance.
* Deep experience delivering software for electronic trading, capital markets, or other high\-performance, mission\-critical, low\-latency systems, with strong working knowledge of trading\-system fundamentals: order lifecycle, exchange gateways, FIX / exchange protocols, market data, price generation, and risk checks.
* Proven track record delivering complex, customer\-committed software projects in an Agile environment — working closely with Product and Project Management on estimation, planning, and CR workflows — and managing multiple concurrent engagements with changing priorities, aggressive timelines, and frequent context switching, while still meeting commitments.
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants and/or agentic developer tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or equivalents) in real delivery — with a clear point of view on where they add leverage, where they don’t, and how to keep quality, security, and IP under control.
* Proficient with Linux, production diagnostics, and debugging / profiling tools (GDB, Address Sanitizer, perf, and similar).
* Demonstrated success as a people manager — growing engineers and SQEs, hiring, calibrating, and handling difficult conversations — with excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills across engineering, Product, Project Management, Client Services, and customers.

**Desirable Skills \& Experience**
* Prior experience leading customer\-funded, professional services, or bespoke\-delivery engineering teams in a financial\-technology context, ideally on a major OMS/EMS/trading platform with exposure to Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, or trading UI.
* Familiarity with major exchange connectivity stacks (CME, ICE, Eurex, LSE, NSE, etc.) and with vendor certification / conformance testing, plus experience with formal CR / change\-management workflows in a regulated financial environment (Jira / Confluence for delivery tracking and design documentation).
* Working knowledge of Python for tooling, automation, and test scaffolding; familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps practices, containerisation, and cloud technologies as applied to trading\-system delivery; background in kernel\-bypass / low\-latency networking (Solarflare, Onload) or lock\-free data structures.
* Track record of driving measurable productivity gains through AI adoption in an engineering team — e.g., accelerating design, code generation, code review, test coverage, or production triage — including establishing guardrails, prompts/skills libraries, and adoption metrics.
  

##### **Benefits**

This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in\-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in\-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands\-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture.

title: BIT Support Engineer
description:
**Job Title: BIT Support Engineer** 

**Location: Ahmedabad**

**Experience: 5–10 Years**

**Employment Type: Full\-Time** 

Role Overview

We are looking for a skilled BIT Support Engineer (L2/L3\) to manage and support our enterprise IT infrastructure, networks, and cloud environments. The role involves handling critical incidents, ensuring high system availability, and acting as an escalation point for complex technical issues in a 24x7 operational setup.

Key Responsibilities

* Monitor and manage IT infrastructure using 24x7 monitoring tools
* Act as L2/L3 escalation point for complex incidents (P1/P2\) and perform root cause analysis (RCA)
* Administer and support Windows/Linux servers and enterprise applications
* Configure and manage network devices (routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs)
* Manage Next\-Generation Firewalls (NGFW) including policies, failover, and performance tuning
* Support data center operations including servers, SAN storage, and virtualization platforms
* Administer VMware/ESXi environments (VM provisioning, snapshots, cluster health)
* Manage and support cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Handle Microsoft 365 ecosystem (Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Azure AD, MFA)
* Ensure infrastructure security using antivirus, EDR tools, and security best practices
* Lead or support IT infrastructure projects (migrations, upgrades, deployments)
* Maintain SOPs, documentation, DR plans, and knowledge base
* Coordinate with vendors/TAMs for issue resolution and hardware/software support
* Mentor and guide junior engineers and improve team performance
* Ensure compliance with IT security standards and regulatory requirements

Required Skills \& Expertise

Technical Skills

* Strong experience in L2/L3 Support \& Incident Management (ITIL framework)
* Hands\-on experience with:
* Windows Server \& Linux (RHEL/Ubuntu)
* Networking (LAN/WAN, VPN, Routers, Switches)
* Firewalls (NGFW – Palo Alto, Fortinet, etc.)
* Virtualization (VMware/ESXi)
* Cloud Platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP)
* Microsoft 365 (Exchange, SharePoint, Azure AD)
* Knowledge of SAN Storage \& Data Center operations
* Familiarity with security tools (EDR, Antivirus) and compliance standards (ISO, PCI, GDPR)

Educational Qualification

* Bachelor’s Degree / Diploma in IT, Electronics, or related field
* Relevant certifications preferred:
* CCNA / CCNP
* Microsoft Certified
* AWS / Azure / Cloud certifications

Soft Skills

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities
* Ability to handle high\-pressure situations (critical outages)
* Good communication \& stakeholder management skills
* Ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines
* Team player with mentoring capabilities

**Note that the candidate would be required to work in rotational shift(morning, night and general).**

Work Location: In person
